title: Cannes before the red carpet
episode: The history of the Cannes Film Festival | Telegraph Time Tunnel
description: A short history of the Cannes Film Festival, from its cancelled start in 1939 to the stars, scandals, and red carpet of the Palais des Festivals, its home since 1983.

title: Cannes in 1959
episode: 1959 CANNES FILM FESTIVAL RAW FOOTAGE (SILENT)   ORSON WELLES, KIM NOVAK, ZSA  ZSA GABOR
description: Silent newsreel footage of the 1959 festival, with Orson Welles, Kim Novak, and the crowds on the Croisette. That year François Truffaut won best director for The 400 Blows.

title: Picasso painting on glass
description: A 1950 Belgian short by Paul Haesaerts in which Picasso paints on a sheet of glass in front of the camera. Picasso was then living in Vallauris, a pottery town near Antibes, where he made thousands of ceramics.

title: The American couple at the center of the Riviera
episode: This Woman Was Picasso, Hemingway, and Fitzgerald's Muse
description: Sara Murphy and her husband Gerald, rich Americans who made Cap d’Antibes a summer gathering place in the 1920s. They cleared seaweed from La Garoupe beach, and friends like Picasso, Hemingway, and the Fitzgeralds came to swim.

title: Sidney Bechet’s wedding in Antibes
description: Home footage of the jazz clarinetist Sidney Bechet’s wedding in Antibes in 1951, with a parade through the streets. The New Orleans musician became a star in France, and the jazz festival at Juan-les-Pins began in 1960.

title: Sister Rosetta Tharpe at Juan-les-Pins
episode: Sister Rosetta Tharpe - live in Antibes (Pt1) [Colourised] 1960-61
description: Colorized film of the gospel and guitar pioneer Sister Rosetta Tharpe playing at Antibes in the early years of Jazz à Juan, the jazz festival held under the pine trees by the beach since 1960.

title: Nietzsche’s daily walk at Èze
episode: Nietzsche Went on This Hike Every Day | Zarathustra Explained
description: A philosophy explainer filmed on the steep path from the sea up to Èze, a medieval village on a rock east of Nice. Nietzsche said he worked out part of Thus Spoke Zarathustra while climbing it in the 1880s.

title: The royal wedding of 1956
episode: Grace Kelly Royal Wedding to Prince Rainer III (1956) | British Pathé
description: British Pathé newsreel of Grace Kelly’s wedding to Prince Rainier III in Monaco’s cathedral in April 1956, watched on television across Europe. Both are buried in the cathedral.

title: A palace for the sea
episode: Engineering Marvel by the Sea: The Oceanographic Museum of Monaco | FD Engineering
description: A documentary on the Oceanographic Museum, built into the cliff in 1910 by Prince Albert I, a pioneering ocean scientist. Jacques Cousteau directed it for more than 30 years.

title: Katherine Mansfield in Menton
description: A documentary portrait of the New Zealand writer Katherine Mansfield, who spent her last winters on the Riviera for her health. She wrote some of her best stories at the Villa Isola Bella in Menton, near the Italian border.
